text.offer: Frular says, "Every member of a guild may carry its shield, and thou shalt have one. The orcs mine an iron in their caves far better than anything left in the Jasper mines. Bring a chunk of it to the smith of Tos, and he will forge thee a shield in thy guild's colours. It weighs nothing, never breaks, and grows stronger as thy guild's prestige grows."
text.progress: Find a chunk of ore in the orc caves and take it to the blacksmith of Tos.
text.complete: The blacksmith turns the ore over in his hands. "Fine iron, this. Here: I've fashioned a shield in your guild's crest and colours. Wear it proudly. And if you want a god's blessing on it, the temples will mark it with their sign."

steps.objective: Ore for the smith of Tos
